description: This file defines the ApplyChecksumMiddleware class, which is part of the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for handling checksum logic in S3 requests. It manages checksum algorithms, headers, and integrates with the middleware stack for AWS S3 operations.

classes.name: ApplyChecksumMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for applying checksum headers to AWS S3 requests, supporting checksums like MD5, SHA256, and CRC32, and ensuring proper integration with AWS SDK command lifecycle.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a wrapper function that instantiates the middleware with a given service API.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next handler in the middleware chain and the AWS service object.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main middleware method that applies checksum logic to the request based on command parameters and operation configuration.

methods.name: addAlgorithmHeader
methods.description: Helper method to add checksum algorithm headers to the request.

methods.name: isS3Express
methods.description: Checks if the request is using the s3express signing service.
